title: 3-Hour Study With Me 🔥 Cozy Fireplace Pomodoro · 3 × 50/10 (No Music While Studying)
description:
Study with me for 3 focused hours beside a warm bedroom fireplace. 🔥 Music plays only in the breaks — during focus you hear nothing but the soft crackle of the fire.

⏱️ FORMAT
• 3 sessions × (50 min focus / 10 min break)
• 10-second countdown to begin
• Soft clock ticks in the last 10 seconds of every phase
• 🎵 Music ONLY during breaks — while you focus, just the gentle crackle of a fireplace

🕖 TIMESTAMPS
00:00 — Intro & 10-second countdown
00:14 — Session 1 · Focus 50:00
50:14 — Break 10:00 (music)
1:00:14 — Session 2 · Focus 50:00
1:50:14 — Break 10:00 (music)
2:00:14 — Session 3 · Focus 50:00
2:50:14 — Break 10:00 (music)
3:00:14 — Well done 🎉

🎧 Best with headphones. Put your phone away and let's get things done.

🌱 Like & subscribe for more study-with-me timers and deep-focus sessions.

Nature & fire ambience from public-domain / Creative Commons sources.
